body.statement: The explicit non-binary law \(P^{\star}\) belongs to \(\mathcal M_{3,0.003}\). At each outcome bin its posterior weights are positive and nonconstant, \(R=D^{-1}BW\), and the exact first elimination is \(N_B=I_9-D^{-1}B(B^{\mathsf T}D^{-1}B)^{-1}B^{\mathsf T}\). The resulting operator is evaluable from nine \((A,Z)\) cells and one conditional Gram matrix of dimension at most eighteen; \(\operatorname{rank}(G)=12\), \(Q\phi\neq0\), \(\phi^{\mathrm{eff}}\in\mathcal T\), and \(V_{\mathrm{raw}}-V_{\mathrm{eff}}\succ0\).
body.justification: An exact continuous witness shows that strict gain is not a hand-tuned finite-table artifact and persists on a regular neighborhood.
body.gap: The presolve calculation is numerical and quadrature-based; the proposition requires an analytic continuous score-membership and covariance calculation.
body.consumer: It provides a reproducible unit test and a concrete design point for calibrating a multilevel hidden-exposure study.
body.proof_tex:
All factors defining \(P^\star\) are rational.  The conditional mean in outcome bin \(b\) is \(b+1/2\), so
\[
m=\left(\frac9{10},\frac32,\frac{21}{10}\right)^{\mathsf T}. \tag{51}
\]
The density entries lie in \([1/10,7/10]\), giving common support and the density envelope at \(\varepsilon=3/1000\), and \(|Y|\leq3\).  Direct diagonalization gives singular values \((1,7/10,7/10)\) for \(M_A\), \((1,2/5,2/5)\) for \(M_Z\), and \((1,3/5,2/5)\) for \(H=\Gamma_Y\).  The modal gap is \(7/10\), and \(\min_j\pi_j=3/10\).

For each outcome bin \(b\), exact rational arithmetic forms
\[
B_{(a,z),j}=M_{A,aj}M_{Z,zj},\quad
w_j=\frac{\pi_jH_{bj}}{\sum_\ell\pi_\ell H_{b\ell}},\quad
D=\operatorname{diag}(Bw),\quad R=D^{-1}BW. \tag{52}
\]
The smallest cell probability over the three bins and nine cells is
\[
\min_{b,a,z}d_{az}=\frac{69}{1600}>\frac3{1000}. \tag{53}
\]
Exact rational signed-remainder evaluations of the three characteristic polynomials give
\[
\frac{38349}{10^6}<\lambda_{\min}(R^{\mathsf T}DR)<\frac{38350}{10^6} \tag{54}
\]
in every bin.  Constructing \(h\) from (52), integrating over the three unit-length bins, and row-reducing the resulting rational \(18\times18\) Gram matrix gives twelve pivots.  Exact sign counts place its twelve nonzero eigenvalues in the disjoint intervals
\[
\begin{gathered}
(3413,3414),(3658,3659),(5796,5797),(7974,7975),
(9442,9443),(14792,14793),\\
(33245,33246),(38068,38069),(46032,46033),(69133,69134),
(91140,91141),(113149,113150),
\end{gathered} \tag{55}
\]
each divided by \(10^6\).  Thus \(\operatorname{rank}G=12\) and its least nonzero eigenvalue exceeds \(3/1000\).  Equations (51)--(55), together with the stated potential-outcome construction, verify every member property of \(\mathcal M_{3,0.003}\), including consistency, ignorability, and three-view independence.  The inequalities are strict.  Bounded factorwise exponential tilts preserve them for sufficiently small path parameters of either sign; the structural bound \(\operatorname{rank}G\leq2K(K-1)=12\) prevents a new Gram direction.  Hence this law is a two-sided pathwise-interior point.

On each bin, \(R,D,N,h\) are constant and \(\phi\) is affine in \(u=y-b\in[0,1]\).  Thus all means and covariances reduce exactly to rational operations using
\(\int_0^1(1,u,u^2)du=(1,1/2,1/3)\).  The resulting raw covariance is
\[
V_{\mathrm{raw}}=
\begin{pmatrix}
67699/8820&2927/7840&5689/13230\\
2927/7840&1357/294&2927/7840\\
5689/13230&2927/7840&67699/8820
\end{pmatrix}. \tag{56}
\]
Writing \(K_0=Q\phi\), the same exact integration and orthogonality of \(Q\) give
\[
V_{\mathrm{raw}}-V_{\mathrm{eff}}=E(K_0K_0^{\mathsf T}). \tag{57}
\]
Exact rational elimination places the three leading principal minors of (57), in order, in
\[
(1114/1000,1115/1000),\qquad(1219/1000,1220/1000),\qquad
(1199/1000,1200/1000). \tag{58}
\]
They are positive, so the symmetric matrix in (57) is positive definite.  In particular \(Q\phi\ne0\).  Theorems 2 and 4 apply at the interior witness and give \(\phi^{\mathrm{eff}}\in\mathcal T\).  Finally, (52), (55), and the definition of \(Q\) show directly that evaluation uses nine cells and one Gram matrix of dimension at most eighteen.  This proves every assertion.
